title: SchoolAI builds an AI platform that empowers teachers
summary: SchoolAI uses GPT-4.1, image generation, and TTS to power safe, teacher-guided AI tools for over 1 million classrooms, improving engagement, oversight, and personalized learning.
body: SchoolAI uses GPT-4.1, image generation, and TTS to power safe, teacher-guided AI tools for over 1 million classrooms, improving engagement, oversight, and personalized learning.
summaryZh: SchoolAI利用GPT-4.1、图像生成及语音合成技术，构建了一个服务于超过100万间教室的AI教育平台。该平台通过教师引导的AI工具，实现了个性化学习路径规划与教学互动，有效提升了课堂参与度与教学管理效率。

aiReview.reasonZh: SchoolAI展示了多模态大模型在教育领域大规模落地的应用场景，对个性化教学具有积极意义。
